response.courseDescription: 241 Engineering Computations Introduction to the computational methods used for solving numerical problems in engineering. (Crosslisted course offered as ME 241, MSE 241.)
response.coursePrerequisites: MATH 273 with a C or better or concur enroll; PHYSICS 205 with a C or better or concur enroll, or 4 cr of PHYSICS 201 with a C or better or concur enroll, PHYSICS 201 and PHYSICS 211 with a C or better or concur enroll in both.
